name: smart-immunizations-uganda
title: SMART Guidelines — Immunizations, Uganda adaptation
description: Uganda (UNEPI) adaptation of the WHO SMART Guidelines immunizations DAK and implementation guide, as a harnessed instance of smart-base. Shaped as litlfred/smart-immunizations is: index.config.json mounts smart-base, and this file declares the instance so its library has a home of its own.

directories.description: L1 sources of the Uganda adaptation: one `<doc_id>/` per ingested document (the Ministry of Health routine immunisation schedule poster and the UNEPI user-requirements deck attached to issue #1), and the image verdicts that describe their figures. The source files themselves are pinned by sha256 in `uploads/<doc_id>/intake.json` and not committed.
